extracted.name: Easy Salmon Dip
extracted.description: This easy salmon dip, made in minutes with canned salmon, cream cheese, sour cream, dill, parsley, garlic, and lemon is perfect for entertaining!
ingredient_lines: 1 (14.75 ounce) can salmon, drained and flaked
instruction_lines: Stir salmon, cream cheese, sour cream, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, dill, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl.
